# expected-invoice-alerts/

## Endpoints / Modules
PRD-05 Phase 6 missing-invoice detection + chase. Alerts are the "supplier owes us an invoice we expected by now" queue.

- `GET  /api/accounting/expected-invoice-alerts` — optional `?status=pending|chased|resolved|dismissed`. Returns alerts joined with supplier name + email + **whatsapp_number** (Phase 8, commit 19a98b4).
- `POST /api/accounting/expected-invoice-alerts/detect-gaps` — manual trigger (cron calls `runDailyExpectationCron` which hits this logic directly). For each locked expectation compute `nextExpectedBy` and INSERT alert ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING when the gap is open.
- `POST /api/accounting/expected-invoice-alerts/[id]/chase` — body `{ method?: 'email' | 'whatsapp' }` default `email`. Routes to `sendEmailChase` or `sendWhatsAppChase`.
- `POST /api/accounting/expected-invoice-alerts/[id]/dismiss` — body `{ reason: string }`. Sets status='dismissed' + dismissed_reason.

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(handler)))`.

## Request / Response
ExpectedAlert shape: `{id, companyId, supplierId, supplierName, supplierEmail, supplierWhatsappNumber, expectationId, expectedBy, expectedAmount, daysOverdue, status, chasedAt, chaseMethod, chaseToAddress, resolvedInvoiceId, resolvedAt, dismissedReason}`.

## Business rules
- **UNIQUE (company_id, supplier_id, expected_by)** — ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes `detectGaps` idempotent; double-running won't create duplicate alerts.
- **Chase channel preference**: cron prefers WhatsApp when `companies.whatsapp_chase_enabled=true` AND supplier has `whatsapp_number`; falls back to email on WA send failure or missing number. Manual UI uses whatever tab the user picks.
- **Auto-resolve on invoice arrival**: `alertResolutionService.resolvePendingAlertForInvoice` is called from 3 `supplier_invoices` INSERT paths (`supplierInvoiceService.createSupplierInvoice`, `ai-invoice-pipeline`, `capture/[id]/post`) — fires a single UPDATE…RETURNING matching any pending alert with `expected_by` within ±14d of `invoice_date`.
